description: This file defines the Perl module Git::SVN::Editor, which implements a commit driver for git-svn operations, adapting SVN::Delta::Editor to convey differences between git trees to a Subversion repository.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Editor
classes.description: A Perl module implementing a commit driver for git-svn, based on SVN::Delta::Editor, to translate git tree differences into SVN commit operations.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the editor with options, prepares diff and path info, and sets up the SVN commit editor.

methods.name: generate_diff
methods.description: Generates a diff between two git trees, returning a list of modifications.

methods.name: check_diff_paths
methods.description: Checks the types of paths involved in the diff, caching their SVN node types.

methods.name: split_path
methods.description: Splits a path into directory and filename components.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Converts a repository-relative path to a full repository path, applying encoding if configured.

methods.name: url_path
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for a given path, escaping characters if URL is HTTP/HTTPS.

methods.name: rmdirs
methods.description: Removes directories from the SVN repository that are no longer present in the diff.

methods.name: open_or_add_dir
methods.description: Opens or adds a directory in the SVN repository, based on its node type.

methods.name: ensure_path
methods.description: Ensures that a given path exists in the SVN repository, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: glob2pat
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern to a regular expression.

methods.name: check_autoprop
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches a pattern for auto-properties and applies them.

methods.name: apply_autoprops
methods.description: Applies auto-properties to a file based on svn config settings.

methods.name: check_attr
methods.description: Checks SVN attributes for a given path.

methods.name: apply_manualprops
methods.description: Applies manual SVN properties to a file based on svn attributes.

methods.name: A
methods.description: Handles addition of a new file in the diff.

methods.name: C
methods.description: Handles copying/adding a file in the diff.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory in the SVN repository.

methods.name: R
methods.description: Handles renaming/moving a file in the diff.

methods.name: M
methods.description: Handles modification of a file.

methods.name: T
methods.description: Handles toggling symlink property on a file.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Changes a file property.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Changes a directory property.

methods.name: _chg_file_get_blob
methods.description: Retrieves a blob object for a file, handling special modes and checksums.

methods.name: chg_file
methods.description: Updates the file content and properties in the SVN repository.

methods.name: D
methods.description: Handles deletion of a file.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the commit, closing directories and cleaning up.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the commit operation.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources.

methods.name: apply_diff
methods.description: Main driver that applies the diff modifications to the SVN repository.
